title: The New Fly Fisher
description: From basics to advanced techniques, experts and guests offer novice and experienced anglers advice for catching pike, trout, salmon, bass and other fresh- and salt-water fish native to North America. Episodes include underwater footage, animated sequences and aerial shots of North American landscapes and wildlife. Locations range from New England, Colorado, Utah and Montana to the Canadian provinces of Ontario, New Brunswick and British Colombia. There is even a trip to the Bahamas.
